content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are platforms that allow you to accept payments without the burden of Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations. This means you can sell your digital products, such as [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-which-architecture-actually-works-3|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]] or courses, without having to provide extensive personal information or verification documents. For many creators in regions like Kenya, this is a game-changer. Traditional payment systems often impose barriers that make it difficult to operate effectively. By using no-KYC gateways, creators can transact with customers directly, ensuring they don't lose sales due to regulatory constraints. Moreover, these systems are typically powered by cryptocurrencies, which provide low transaction fees and faster processing times compared to traditional payment methods.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of no-KYC payment gateways is designed for simplicity and efficiency. At its core, it uses blockchain technology to facilitate transactions, ensuring that payments are processed directly between the buyer and the seller. For instance, systems like NOWPayments allow creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. The payment verification occurs on-chain, meaning once a transaction is confirmed, it triggers automatic delivery of the digital product. This architecture eliminates the need for middlemen, reducing costs and streamlining the sales process. With tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, your backend can automatically handle order management and file delivery, further enhancing the operational efficiency of your online store.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This no-KYC payment infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who have been locked out of traditional payment platforms. Whether you are an ebook author, an online course instructor, or a software developer, this architecture empowers you to monetize your skills without dependency on outdated payment systems. This setup is particularly relevant for creators in regions like Kenya, where financial exclusion is prevalent. By using a decentralized approach, you retain full control over your business operations. You don’t rely on external platforms that can impose restrictions or change terms at will. Ultimately, this is about enabling creators to thrive independently and sustainably in the digital economy.
Empower yourself with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The no-KYC payment model comprises several key components that work in unison to create a fully functional online store. Firstly, there’s the hosting platform, which can be GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to publish your products freely. Next, backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring seamless order processing. Storage is managed through databases like Supabase or even Google Sheets, where order data is securely kept. File delivery, crucial for digital products, is managed using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, payment processing is facilitated by NOWPayments, which manages cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. Together, these components create a sovereign commerce stack that is robust, flexible, and independent.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your no-KYC payment gateway and start selling your digital products, begin by choosing the appropriate infrastructure components based on your needs. Start with hosting your site on GitHub Pages for free. Next, set up the backend using Cloudflare Workers for scalable processing. Use Supabase to manage your order data, and integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. Ensure you have your digital products ready for delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. As a first step, consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit, which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to get started quickly and effectively. This kit simplifies the deployment process, allowing you to focus on what you do best: creating.

Frequently Asked Questions
What are no-KYC payment gateways?

No-KYC payment gateways are platforms that allow you to accept payments without requiring personal identification or extensive verification. This is particularly beneficial for digital creators in regions where traditional payment options are unavailable.
How do these gateways work?

These gateways use blockchain technology to process payments directly between buyers and sellers, eliminating the need for intermediaries. They facilitate cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring fast and low-cost processing.
Who can benefit from using no-KYC payment gateways?
Digital creators, including ebook authors, course instructors, and software developers, can benefit from no-KYC payment gateways, especially in regions with financial exclusion.
What infrastructure is needed to set this up?
You need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, a backend processing tool like Cloudflare Workers, and a payment processor such as NOWPayments to create a no-KYC payment system.
